deadline.value: Fall applications are due January 31; spring applications are due October 1.

gre_general.value: The catalog lists a General GRE score submission as a program requirement.
gre_general.quote: Submission of scores on the General Test of the Graduate Record Examination.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: A faculty member must accept the applicant as major professor, which is needed before admission.

funding.value: Thesis-track students get a graduate assistantship from their major professor; professional-track students are not assistantship-supported.
funding.quote: Students in the thesis program must secure a faculty advisor who will serve as the major professor and provide a graduate assistantship.

also.quote: Students in the professional program are not supported by assistantships.
